title: Whole Exome and RNA Sequencing Analyses of PDAC Samples
author: Do Young Hyeon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-2062/v1
materials: SureSelect Human All Exon v5 probe set

DNA and RNA were extracted according to the Allspin (GeneAll) total DNA/RNA purification protocol. Briefly, the tissue powder was immersed in RNAlater reagent (R0901, Sigma-Aldrich) immediately after homogenization. Buffer CTL (+β-mercaptoethanol; 350 µL) and tungsten carbide beads (3 mm) were added to the sample tubes; the tissue powder was further lysed by Tissuelyzer at ˗25 Hz for 3 min. The lysate was incubated for 10 min at room temperature, and the lysate in the spin column was centrifuged at 10,000 g for 3 min to separate the DNA and RNA. The pass-through was used for RNA extraction, and the remaining lysate in the mini spin column was used for DNA extraction. The concentration and integrity were measured using a bioanalyzer (Agilent) before library construction.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Process tumor tissues to ensure consistency across genomic, proteomic, and pathological analyses.

substeps.instruction: Cryo-pulverize tumor tissues to obtain a fine tissue powder.
Divide the powder into aliquots: approximately 3 mg for DNA and RNA isolation, and 15 mg for protein extraction.

steps.title: Perform Whole Exome Sequencing (WES)
steps.instruction: Capture and sequence the exome using the SureSelect Human All Exon v5 probe set following the Agilent SureSelect Target Enrichment protocol (version B.3, June 2015).

substeps.instruction: Hybridize >100 ng of genomic DNA onto capture probes for 24 h on a thermal cycler.
Perform quantification and quality control using TapeStation DNA ScreenTape D1000 (Agilent) and quantitative PCR (qPCR) after library construction.
Sequence libraries with paired-end 101 bp reads on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 platform, ensuring WES depths of at least 100× for blood samples and 300× for tumor samples.

steps.title: Process WES Data and Call Variants
steps.instruction: Map reads and identify somatic and germline variants using a bioinformatics pipeline.

substeps.instruction: Map FASTQ reads to the GRCh38 genome using BWA (version 0.7.17) with the MEM algorithm.
Generate, sort, and index BAM files from SAM files using Samtools (version 1.4.1).
Remove duplicate reads using Picard (version 2.18.7).
Pre-process data using IndelRealigner and BaseRecalibrator modules of GATK (version 3.8).
Identify germline variants in blood samples using HaplotypeCaller.
Call somatic variants from tumors compared with matched blood samples using Mutect2 (version 3.8) according to GATK best practices.

steps.title: Analyze Somatic Mutations and CNVs
steps.instruction: Identify significantly mutated genes (SMGs) and copy number variations (CNVs).

substeps.instruction: Identify SMGs from VCF files using MutSigCV (version 1.4), defining SMGs as mutated genes with a q value < 0.05 (excluding biallelic somatic SNVs).
Annotate exonic variants using ANNOVAR (version 2018Apr16), convert tables to MAF files, and visualize using the maftools R package.
Categorize variants into missense, nonsense, in-frame insertions/deletions, and frameshift insertions/deletions using snpEff (version 4.3t).
Apply CNVkit (version 0.9.6) to WES data for segmented copy data, filtering out data not corresponding with the 22 major autosomes and sex chromosomes.
Analyze filtered CNV data using GISTIC2.0 (version 2.0.22) to identify copy number-altered genomic regions and genes.
Define exome coverage as shared genomic regions between capture probe regions and callable regions using GATK CallableLoic.
Calculate tumor mutation burden as the number of protein sequence-altering variants divided by the exome coverage.

steps.title: Perform Exome Capture RNA Sequencing
steps.instruction: Isolate and sequence the mRNA encoding exome to overcome RNA degradation in PDAC tissues.

substeps.instruction: Quantify total RNA using Quant-IT RiboGreen and run on TapeStation RNA ScreenTape to calculate DV200 (percentage of fragments > 200 nucleotides).
Isolate the mRNA encoding exome from >100 ng of total RNA using Illumina TruSeq RNA exome per manufacturer instructions.
Construct a strand-specific cDNA library with adaptor ligation.
Sequence with paired-end 101 bp reads using the Illumina HiSeq 2500 platform.

steps.title: Process RNA Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Trim, align, and quantify gene expression from RNA-seq reads.

substeps.instruction: Trim adaptors and low-quality or short reads using Trimmomatic (version 0.36).
Align trimmed reads to the GRCh38 genome using STAR (version 2.5.3a).
Quantify gene expression levels using RSEM (version 1.3.0) according to GENCODE v27 GTF annotation.
